title: Ambient scalar quotient comparison on the good localization
statement:
theorem ambientQuotientScalarModel_good_comparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (X : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X) :
    Nonempty ((integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E X) ⋙
      (S.reduction ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X ⋙
        coefficientSequenceLimit l L X) ≅
      integralScalarOnGood l E L ι X)

proof.text: On every flat-term K-flat complex, use the balanced association (x tensor a) tensor b ↦ x tensor iota(a)b and its unit inverse. It commutes with quotient transitions and the Roos cone, so it gives the displayed natural isomorphism on the good localization.
